## Tom Cruise has gifted Doan’s Bakery’s White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake to celebrities every Christmas for years


The Tom Cruise cake is the **White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake from Doan’s Bakery** in Woodland Hills, California. It’s a moist coconut Bundt studded with white chocolate chunks, frosted with cream cheese, and buried in toasted coconut flakes. It’s the cake Hollywood’s A-list waits for every December, and yes, you can order one shipped to your door.


[Order the Tom Cruise Cake on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery/white-chocolate-coconut-bundt-cake)


## **What Is the Tom Cruise Cake?**


The Tom Cruise cake is a one-layer Bundt cake made with coconut cake batter and white chocolate chunks, slathered in cream cheese frosting and coated with toasted coconut flakes. It’s baked by the family-owned Doan’s Bakery, founded by Karen Doan in 1983 and now run with her son Eric and his wife Carrie.


The cake has exactly ten ingredients: butter, coconut, cream cheese, eggs, flour, powdered sugar, sour cream, sugar, vanilla, and white chocolate. It’s 10 inches, serves 12 to 16 people, and costs $139.95 on Goldbelly.


**Read More:[What is a Bundt Cake?](https://blog.goldbelly.com/what-is-a-bundt-cake/)**


## **Why Do They Call It the Tom Cruise Cake?**


Every December, Tom Cruise ships this cake to a list of close friends and celebrity co-stars as a Christmas gift. His A-list recipients have nicknamed it “the Tom Cruise cake” and “the Tom Cruise Christmas cake,” and the names stuck.


The story starts with actress Diane Keaton, who introduced Katie Holmes to Doan’s Bakery while filming *Mad Money* together. Holmes was married to Cruise at the time, Doan’s later catered a party at the Cruise home, and Tom was hooked. He’s been sending the cake every Christmas since.


Known recipients of the Tom Cruise cake include: Angela Bassett, Henry Cavill, Cary Elwes, Kirsten Dunst, Jay Ellis, Jimmy Fallon, Elle and Dakota Fanning, Jon Hamm, Tom Hanks, Graham Norton, Rosie O’Donnell, Brooke Shields, Cobie Smulders, Miles Teller, Courtney B. Vance, and Renée Zellweger.


## **Who Makes the Tom Cruise Cake?**


**[Doan’s Bakery](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery)** makes the Tom Cruise cake. It’s the Woodland Hills, California bakery’s signature item. Karen Doan opened the bakery in 1983, and the White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake has been its most famous creation ever since. The bakery makes six other Bundt cake flavors, including a **[Carrot Bundt Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery/carrot-bundt-cake)** , but none with the celebrity following of the coconut.


## **How Much Is The Tom Cruise Cake?**


The Tom Cruise cake is **$139.95 on Goldbelly** . It ships nationwide and arrives ready to serve.


## **Where to Order the Tom Cruise Cake in 2026**


You don’t need to be on Tom Cruise’s Christmas list. **[Doan’s Bakery’s White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake ships nationwide on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery/white-chocolate-coconut-bundt-cake)** — order it for yourself, or send it as a gift exactly the way Cruise does.


It’s 10 inches, serves 12 to 16 people, and ships in Doan’s signature packaging. Available year-round, not just at Christmas.
